title: Shrine of Baba Farid
source: Pakistan Department of Archaeology and Museums, Tomb of Baba Farid record 9694
identityStatus: Pakistan’s Tomb of Baba Farid record 9694 locates the specific monument. The measured 5.2 m square chamber and documented east and south door bearings provide its plan. OpenStreetMap way 174504957 corroborates the wider precinct.

terrainContact.basis: Unmodified open elevation sample at the archaeology record’s independent tomb location.

notes: The original architectural survey describes the near-cubic marble and masonry chamber, cusped dome on pendentives, black lettering above the main entrance and tall pinnacle. The dome profile, exterior details and platform are approximate.
